versions.title: Algorithm Trace Workbench and Performance Optimization
versions.titleZh: 算法追踪工作台与方法论性能优化
versions.themeZh: 可审计追踪 + 加载性能
versions.summary: Added an Algorithm Trace Workbench for run-level auditability, replaced the global Catalysis cat overlay with chart-scoped probes, and optimized Methods & Evidence loading without changing OACS/DMRS scientific logic.
versions.summaryZh: 新增 Algorithm Trace Workbench 用于运行级可审计追踪，将全局 Catalysis 小猫 overlay 改为图表内探针，并优化 Methods & Evidence 加载；不改变 OACS/DMRS 科学逻辑。
keyUpdates: Added Algorithm Trace Workbench with runId, step-level trace records, candidate decision log, formula / weight inspector, evidence trace, candidate flow funnel, warnings, boundaries, and Markdown / JSON export.
Replaced the workspace-level cat overlay with a chart-scoped science probe inside Scaffold, Dopant, and Synergy Hot Spot charts.
Optimized Methods & Evidence through lazy component loading, on-demand Knowledge Base fetches, collapsed heavy matrices, deferred methodology sections, skeleton states, and Vite manual chunks.
keyUpdatesZh: 新增 Algorithm Trace Workbench，包含 runId、step-level trace records、candidate decision log、formula / weight inspector、evidence trace、candidate flow funnel、warnings、boundaries 与 Markdown / JSON export。
将全工作区小猫 overlay 改为仅挂载在 Scaffold、Dopant、Synergy 热区图内的 chart-scoped science probe。
通过组件懒加载、Knowledge Base 按需 fetch、重型矩阵折叠、方法论分段延迟渲染、skeleton 状态和 Vite manual chunks 优化 Methods & Evidence。
algorithmChanges: No OACS/DMRS core scoring logic change.
Run Launcher now emits an exportable V1.7 trace object in addition to legacy trace records.
Trace records expose inputs, rules, formulas, outputs, warnings, and blocked states for demo / mapped fixture / curated real-example runs.
algorithmChangesZh: 不改变 OACS/DMRS 核心评分逻辑。
Run Launcher 在 legacy trace records 之外新增可导出的 V1.7 trace object。
trace records 对 demo / mapped fixture / curated real-example 运行暴露 input、rule、formula、output、warning 与 blocked 状态。
uiChanges: Added Trace Workbench cards for run overview, step timeline, step inspector, candidate decision log, formula / weight inspector, evidence trace panel, candidate flow funnel, warning boundary panel, and export panel.
Cat probe now uses pointer events, chart-relative coordinates, clamped movement, and independent storage keys for hotspot-scaffold, hotspot-dopant, and hotspot-synergy.
Methods & Evidence shows lightweight skeletons, summary-first literature lists, collapsed matrices, and nonblank lazy-loaded methodology sections.
uiChangesZh: 新增 run overview、step timeline、step inspector、candidate decision log、formula / weight inspector、evidence trace panel、candidate flow funnel、warning boundary panel 与 export panel。
小猫探针改用 pointer events、图表相对坐标、边界内 clamp，以及 hotspot-scaffold、hotspot-dopant、hotspot-synergy 独立 storage keys。
Methods & Evidence 使用轻量 skeleton、摘要优先文献列表、默认折叠矩阵，以及非空白懒加载方法论区块。
methodologyChanges: Added Algorithm Trace Workbench method note to Organic Acid Final Screening methodology.
Knowledge Base and Version History now document V1.7 traceability, chart-scoped probe boundaries, and performance optimization boundaries.
Large public JSON datasets are fetched on demand by methodology / Knowledge Base surfaces instead of being statically imported into the main bundle.
methodologyChangesZh: 在 Organic Acid Final Screening 方法论中新增 Algorithm Trace Workbench 方法说明。
Knowledge Base 与 Version History 记录 V1.7 可追踪性、chart-scoped probe 边界与性能优化边界。
大型 public JSON 数据由方法论 / Knowledge Base 页面按需 fetch，不再静态进入主 bundle。
versions.evidenceBoundary: Trace workbench provides auditability and transparency for demo / mapped / curated sample workflows. It does not prove catalytic performance.
versions.evidenceBoundaryZh: Trace workbench 为 demo / mapped / curated sample 工作流提供可审计性与透明度；不证明催化性能。
limitations: Trace records explain the current computation chain but do not validate catalytic outcomes.
Chart-scoped cat probe zones are interpretive overlays on demo/proxy hot spot maps.
Performance optimization changes loading behavior only; it does not advance full CoRE/QMOF database screening.
limitationsZh: trace records 解释当前计算链，但不验证催化结果。
chart-scoped cat probe zones 是 demo/proxy 热区图上的解释性 overlay。
性能优化只改变加载行为；不推进全量 CoRE/QMOF 数据库筛选。

literatureInspirations.adaptationNote: Borrowed structured-data and auditability principles only; EcoMOF-AI does not reproduce HTE yield modelling.
literatureInspirations.adaptationNoteZh: 仅借鉴结构化数据与可审计原则；EcoMOF-AI 不复现 HTE 产率建模。
literatureInspirations.evidenceBoundary: Methodology principle only; not validation of trace-derived recommendations.

literatureInspirations.adaptationNote: Borrowed chart-level interpretability inspiration only; EcoMOF-AI does not reproduce the paper's model or conclusions.
literatureInspirations.adaptationNoteZh: 仅借鉴图表级解释性呈现；EcoMOF-AI 不复现原论文模型或结论。
literatureInspirations.evidenceBoundary: Visualization inspiration only; not evidence that the EcoMOF-AI hot spot predicts performance.

knowledgeBaseLinks.adaptationBoundary: Traceability, chart interpretability, and loading-performance improvements only; no change to OACS/DMRS formulas and no catalytic validation claim.
knowledgeBaseLinks.adaptationBoundaryZh: 仅涉及可追踪性、图表解释性与加载性能优化；不改变 OACS/DMRS 公式，也不声明催化验证。

versions.title: Large-scale Database Index Architecture
versions.titleZh: 大规模数据库索引架构
versions.summary: Added the public database_index data layer and scripts for manifest generation, preview summaries, index parts, detail records, validation, and dry-run precompute.
versions.summaryZh: 新增 public database_index 数据层与脚本链路，用于 manifest、preview summary、index parts、detail records、validator 与 dry-run precompute。
keyUpdates: Added public/data/database_index/ with manifest, summaries, descriptor availability, provenance coverage, precomputed top candidates, index parts, detail records, build report, and validation report.
Added scripts/database-index/ build, precompute, split, validate, and shared utility scripts.
Added database_index_preview datasetMode and not full database screening boundary.
Fixed validator classification for metadata, statistics, percentages, array containers, and index part records.
keyUpdatesZh: 新增 public/data/database_index/，包含 manifest、summary、descriptor availability、provenance coverage、precomputed top candidates、index parts、detail records、build report 与 validation report。
新增 scripts/database-index/ build、precompute、split、validate 与 shared utility scripts。
新增 database_index_preview datasetMode 与 not full database screening 边界。
修复 validator 对 metadata、statistics、percent、array container 和 index part records 的分类。
algorithmChanges: No browser-side full database scoring.
Precomputed Top-N preview excludes needs-review and rejected records from final recommendation.
Detail records remain on-demand and separated from lightweight index parts.
algorithmChangesZh: 不在浏览器端执行全量数据库评分。
预计算 Top-N preview 将 needs-review 与 rejected 记录排除在最终推荐之外。
详情记录保持按需加载，并与轻量 index parts 分离。
uiChanges: No front-end workbench yet in V2.0-A; this release established the data and script architecture.
uiChangesZh: V2.0-A 尚未接入前端工作台；本版本建立数据与脚本架构。
methodologyChanges: Documented database index preview as an architecture boundary, not full verified screening.
methodologyChangesZh: 将 database index preview 记录为架构边界，不是经过完整验证的全量筛选。
versions.evidenceBoundary: Database index architecture preview only; not full verified database screening.
versions.evidenceBoundaryZh: 仅为数据库索引架构预览；不是经过完整验证的全量数据库筛选。
limitations: Preview records do not represent the complete raw CoRE/QMOF databases.
DOI, citation, and license fields remain pending when unverified.
Top candidates are preview candidates, not final verified recommendations.
limitationsZh: 预览记录不代表完整 CoRE/QMOF 原始数据库。
未经核验时 DOI、citation 与 license 保持 pending。
Top candidates 是预览候选，不是最终验证推荐。

knowledgeBaseLinks.adaptationBoundary: Architecture and validation scaffold only; no verified full database screening claim.
knowledgeBaseLinks.adaptationBoundaryZh: 仅为架构与校验脚手架；不声明已完成经验证的全量数据库筛选。

keyUpdates: Added Database Index Workbench UI.
Added manifest and summary fetch logic.
Added descriptor availability and provenance coverage panels.
Added precomputed top candidates preview.
Added index part browser.
Added detail-on-demand drawer.
Added Database index preview mode to Run Launcher.
Added index-level trace boundary to Algorithm Trace Workbench.
keyUpdatesZh: 新增 Database Index Workbench UI。
新增 manifest 与 summary fetch 逻辑。
新增 descriptor availability 与 provenance coverage panels。
新增 precomputed top candidates preview。
新增 index part browser。
